observations: A large teal-grey rounded form dominates the center, carrying two yellow spiral eyes and a jagged yellow mouth line across its lower edge.
Black coiled spring lines run along the right side and bottom, contrasting with loose red scribble loops and a small blue flower cluster in the upper right corner.
Two dark rectangular forms flank the central shape, each marked with white crown zigzags and crossed-box symbols; orange vertical bars fill the upper left behind a pink wave line.
reading: The large teal form holds the image like a mask pinned between two dark flanking shapes, its spiral eyes pulling the gaze inward while the jagged mouth edge pushes outward. Coiled black lines along the right edge feel taut against the loose red loops scattered elsewhere. The white crown marks on the flanking shapes read as repeated signals, giving the whole surface a charged, watchful quality.
